claim: Evidence-grounded generation scheduling over fixed Refine contract-owning theory slots.
forbidden_planner_inputs: raw human Refine theory sources or imports
human helper names, statements, proof order, dependency graph, or export plan
individual Premise Catalog records or retrieval statistics

model.role: Propose evidence-citing contract-composition and operation-call priority edges; never emit the final schedule.

rules.contract-composition: Validated edges form scheduling layers. Cycles are collapsed and disclosed.
rules.edge-grounding: Every accepted edge cites current contracts from both endpoints and shares at least one non-generic identifier across those endpoint contracts.
rules.operation-call: Validated edges affect only serial order inside one composition layer. They never claim a proof dependency.
rules.same-layer: No accepted contract-composition evidence separates the theories; this does not assert semantic independence.
rules.tie-break: Among currently ready weak-edge components, sort by outgoing weak-edge count descending and then theory name ascending.
